title: Only verified callers status and refusal (v1)
description: `status.data.callerVerification` and the `data` of a `caller_not_verified` refusal (Tactical 161). The mode is opt-in and changed only from the native operator surface. It is a picket fence against callers that were not started from an operator-approved app, not same-user containment. A resident that projects it without an implementation reports supported=false and mode off.

supported.description: Whether this build and platform can verify callers. A source or ad-hoc build reports false with unsupportedReason.

storageInvalid.description: The saved choice could not be trusted; the resident enforces verified_only until the operator changes it.

approvedHosts.description: Display labels only, never requirements or signing identifiers.

discoveryOperations.description: Operations that remain available to unverified callers so they can diagnose a refusal.

refusal.description: data of a result or admission-channel reply whose errorCode is caller_not_verified.

oneOf.description: No host app was found, for example a detached background process.

approvalPrompt.description: For an approvable host: whether a native Allow prompt is on the operator's screen. The refused request is never replayed.
